o1: Enables DNA-binding transcription factor activity. Involved in neuron differentiation; non-motile cilium assembly; positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; and response to oxidative stress. Is located in nucleus. Is expressed in AWB; D; body wall muscle cell from D lineage; head muscle; somatic nervous system; and intestine. Orthologous to several human genes including FOXG1 (forkhead box G1).
